verdict.rationale: Asana publishes official OpenAPI specs in its Asana/openapi GitHub repo, covering both the REST API (defs/asana_oas.yaml) and app components (defs/app_components_oas.yaml). An AI-native user can download a machine-readable spec. The probe's 404s on conventional paths like /openapi.json mean the spec is not served from a well-known URL on the docs site, but they do not contradict the repo. Missing for 10: discoverability at a standard or .well-known URL on developers.asana.com, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and current.
